pages.text: $(thing)Colorado Potato Beetle$() ($(o)Leptinotarsa decemlineata$()), insect.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() potato, tomato.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() migration, soilborne.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 15-32 °C (best 26 °C).

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 1 years (adults in soil).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 60% yield, can kill the plant.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Rotate fields far apart; Hand-pick adults and egg masses; Straw mulch; Bt tenebrionis.
Famous for evolving resistance to almost every insecticide used against it.
